items: Start here: Leica TS09 Plus, listing #2475. A deal is ready to ship. On 6 Oct the seller Raitis (Vinoko, Latvia) wrote that the price agreed was $4,500 (negotiation #00938). He asked what to put in the 'Certificate' field and which delivery address to ship to. Reply today with the inspection-centre address and instructions. This run assigned Odoo #3352 to you. ABDALLA's earlier SAR 10,000 offer (#3138) was a different, lower offer, so tell him the unit is taken.
NVOLVE S00381 (€51,500, 5× HiPer VR + OAF), your highest-value quote: it has been a draft for 12 days. Send it today and update #677, which is logged at $25.6k.
GEOSURVEYS (Angola, $30,620): FMCGL booked UPS 1Z2BJ3320421584083 on 5 Oct. Send the tracking number to Ricardo and ask for payment of AE000117 before delivery.

New buyers from Machinio, reply today. Antwi Gye Nyame (Ghana) wants a Leica TM60 0.5" R1000 (#3408); we hold a TM60 1" R1000 (listing #2422). Yasar Uere (Germany), DS2000 GPR, #3092 ($20k): he has now waited 5 days. Georges is checking a DS2000 with David (#3246). Agree with Zein who owns it and answer the buyer.

Escalations past day 7: Ivica Pojatina (#722, TS16 I 3", 52 days) and Mario Roothooft (#792, CSI2140 to sell, 39 days). Call both yourself.
